0022600030.text: The Raptors (4-4, 2-3 on the road, 5th in the East) visit the Bucks (1-7, 1-3 at home, 15th in the East) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group A game, Toronto's ninth of the season. Toronto is on a one-game losing streak, while Milwaukee has lost four straight; Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture) are out for the Raptors, Scottie Barnes (groin soreness) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, and Kam Jones (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision for the Bucks. Toronto won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 122-94 win in Milwaukee on February 22, 2026, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27.
